Carmen (Docs): Quick sync: I'm landing a compact troubleshooting doc for 429s, timeouts, and context-limit fallbacks. Need tiny SDK snippets + a short harness. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523 — can folks review?
Ibrahim (SDK): I can add a Python + TS snippet showing Retry-After and X-Redwood-Retry-Window precedence. I'll keep examples minimal.
Maya (eng-runtime): Note: runtime sometimes emits only X-Redwood-Retry-Window for sub-2s windows. Recommend: parse numeric Retry-After first, then X-Redwood-Retry-Window, then HTTP-date parse. For burst 429s: immediate jittered retry; for sustained: fallback to quantized model or queue.
Leo (QA): I'll produce a short harness demonstrating context trim -> backend timeout -> 429. Will sanitize logs and include curl + node replay. File path suggestion: docs/err-ref/examples/429-mini-harness.md.
Carmen (Docs): Also need suggested end-user microcopy. Proposal: "Service busy — please try again shortly." Keep it short.
docs-bot: Label added: err-ref
Ibrahim (SDK): Added snippets and note about HTTP-date parsing. Pushed to PR. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523/files
Carmen (Docs): Thanks — will merge after one more runtime + QA ok.
